claims.value: Carved male figure, moai kavakava, made of wood, bone, obsidian.
Height: 43 centimetres Width: 10 centimetres Depth: 7 centimetres

Letter from vendor dated 3.8.1933 explains that he bought the figure (lot 161) at a sale of furniture and effects held on July 26th & 27th at the home of Lord Hothfield (Hothfield Place, near Ashford, Kent). He says 'I noticed the figure bore a label with No.3 Signed "Hugh Cumings"
